title: Guest Wi-Fi Connection Guide
problem: Employee or guest cannot connect to the Bridgestone Guest Wi-Fi network.
prerequisites: Guest Wi-Fi credentials received from the Network Team.

troubleshooting_steps.title: Select Guest Wi-Fi
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Open available Wi-Fi networks and connect to BS-Guest (Chakan) or BSGUEST (Kheda).
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Available Wi-Fi Networks

troubleshooting_steps.title: Open Login Portal
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: If the login page does not open automatically, open a web browser and navigate to any website to trigger the captive portal.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Guest Wi-Fi Portal

troubleshooting_steps.title: Enter Credentials
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: Enter the User ID and Password provided by the Network Team.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Authentication Page

troubleshooting_steps.title: Verify Internet Access
troubleshooting_steps.instruction: After successful login, verify internet connectivity by opening a website.
troubleshooting_steps.caption: Internet Connected

common_errors.resolution: Open a browser and visit any HTTP website to trigger the login page.
Verify the credentials received from the Network Team.
Disconnect and reconnect to the Guest Wi-Fi network.

escalation.condition: Escalate if login portal or authentication continues to fail.

faq.question: Which Wi-Fi should I connect to?
faq.answer: Use BS-Guest at Chakan or BSGUEST at Kheda.
